likely_causes.cause: Thermostat not calling for cool, or wrong mode/setpoint
Dirty filter or closed vents cutting airflow
Outdoor unit blocked or not running
Failed capacitor, contactor, or low refrigerant

homeowner_checks: Confirm thermostat is in Cool and the setpoint is below room temperature
Replace or clean the return filter
Check the furnace switch and outdoor disconnect are on
Look at the outdoor unit for ice, debris, or a silent fan
tech_only: Contactor or line-voltage work at the outdoor unit
call_pro_when: Cooling call is on for several minutes but compressor amps stay near zero, or the outdoor unit hums without starting.
sources: Generic residential AC practice (filter, breaker, thermostat first)
assumptions: Single-stage AC with gas furnace unless the equipment profile says otherwise
